metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the standard-library BibTeX tool at [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py). It parses `.bib` files, executes `.bst` styles, writes a UTF-8 `.bbl`, and produces the requested JSON log and error output.

All four supplied styles ran successfully on a 14-entry fixture. I also checked parse and runtime error handling, and verified the cmr10 width table against all 95 definitions in `bibtex.web`. Byte-for-byte parity against a historic BibTeX binary has not been independently tested.
